rows.title_full: AN ACT INCREASING THE PENALTY FOR THE UNAUTHORIZED SLAUGHTERING OF CARABAOS, HORSES, MARES, AND COWS, AMENDING FOR THE PURPOSE REPUBLIC ACT NO. 11, ENTITLED 'AN ACT TO PROHIBIT THE SLAUGHTERING OF MALE AND FEMALE CARABAOS, HORSES, MARES, AND COWS'
rows.abstract: Rationale: "Being an agricultural country, most of the Filipinos rely on farming as their chief soource of livelihood. Thus, it is important to maintain a sufficient population of work animals throughout the country to meet farmer's needs.  It is inthis context that Republic Act No. 11 was enacted in 1946.  Lately, however, it has been observed notwithstanding this law and its punitive provisions, indiscriminate slaughtering of carabaos, horses, mares, and cows continue tht Republic Act No. 11has outlived its effectivity. People nowadays do not seem to be deterred by the rather light penalties prescribed under the Republic Act No. 11 hence, the need to impose stiffer penalties."

rows.title_full: AN ACT TO INCREASE THE RETIREMENT PAY OF PNP PERSONNEL, AMENDING FOR THE PURPOSE SECTION SEVENTY-FIVE OF REPUBLIC ACT NUMBERED SIXTY NINE HUNDRED AND SEVENTY-FIVE (police)
rows.abstract: Amends Section 75 of RA 6975 to read as follows: "Section 75. Retirement Benefits. Monthly retirement pay shall be fifty percent (50%) of the base pay and longevity pay of the retired grade in case of twenty (20) years of active service, increasingby two and one-half percent (2.5%) for every year of active service rendered beyond twenty (20) years to a maximum of ninety percent (90%) for thirty-six (36) years of active service.  IT SHALL LIKEWISE, INCLUDE THE SUBSISTENCE AND COST OF LIVING ALLOWANCES, AND HAZARD PAY AUTHORIZED IN SECTION SEVENTY-ONE OF THE SAME ACT."
rows.status: Substituted by HB10089
